author: mizzy
title: [bug] CloudControl:GetResource returns AWS::SSM::Parameter desired-state unchanged; not backed by SSM
closing_comment_excerpt: Fixed in #35: an `AWS::SSM::Parameter` created through Cloud Control is now an ordinary SSM parameter, and `GetResource` is rebuilt from SSM state, so it returns `Arn` and `DataType`, omits the write-only `Description`, and `ssm get-parameter` finds the parameter. SSM's parameter model has no fields for `Description`, `Tier`, `AllowedPattern` or `Policies`, so those inputs are still dropped on the SSM side. Released in winterbaume-cloudcontrol v1.2.0 and winterbaume-ssm v0.3.1.
